# QS-CFW-6874-71 - Quality specification - gear blank CFW-6874-71 (8620)

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1  
Part(s): CFW-6874-71

Scope
- This document defines the acceptance criteria and inspection method for gear blank CFW-6874-71 (CFW-6874-71) manufactured at Plant P1. It applies to the forging, heat treat acceptance, and final inspection prior to release for machining.

Requirements table

| Characteristic | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for gear blank CFW-6874-71 (CFW-6874-71) is 38-42 HRC. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for gear blank CFW-6874-71 (CFW-6874-71) is ±0.07 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for gear blank CFW-6874-71 (CFW-6874-71) is 113.4 kg. |

Inspection method
- Visual inspection: Verify part identity and surface condition to ensure no defects that would affect fit or function.
- Hardness inspection: Perform hardness readings on representative locations across the workpiece and compare to the requirement stated in the table. Use calibrated Rockwell equipment and record results on the inspection record.
- Dimensional inspection: Verify bore diameter and other critical dimensions using calibrated gauging appropriate for the tolerance range stated in the table. Document actual measured values on the inspection report.
- Weight verification: Confirm forging weight against the maximum forging weight requirement at receipt from the forge source or at final inspection. Record weight on the inspection record.
- Records: Maintain inspection records and calibration certificates with the lot paperwork for traceability.

Nonconformance handling
- Suspect or nonconforming material shall be segregated and tagged pending disposition.
- Notify Quality and the responsible process owner for evaluation and disposition.
- Disposition options include rework, repair, or scrapping based on root cause and capability to meet the requirements shown in this document.
- Final disposition and corrective actions shall be documented and retained with the batch records.
